description: Every substructure of a model of a universal first-order theory is again a model of that theory.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.models_of_isUniversal.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (S : L.Substructure M) (T : L.Theory) [T.IsUniversal] [M ⊨ T] : ↥S ⊨ T
